description: This file contains unit tests for functions related to processing inbound messaging contexts and text normalization in a messaging application. It tests the normalization of newline characters in text and verifies the structure and content of various inbound message contexts across multiple messaging platforms.

methods.name: normalizeInboundTextNewlines
methods.description: Normalizes different newline representations in input text, converting carriage return variations to Unix-style line endings while preserving literal backslash-n sequences.

methods.name: expectChannelInboundContextContract
methods.description: A test helper function that verifies the correctness and structure of the inbound message context object against expected contract.

methods.name: finalizeInboundContext
methods.description: Processes a raw inbound message context to finalize its structure for further handling or testing.

ctags.name: cases
ctags.pattern: /^  const cases: Array<{ name: string; ctx: MsgContext }> = [$/
